item.title: GET YOUR SKATES ON
item.description: Beyond reports on how Another Place, The Lake will be transformed into a magical Christmas escape over the coming months with the return of their ice rink and so much more. The post GET YOUR SKATES ON appeared first on Beyond Magazine.

item.title: YORE IN FOR A TREAT
item.description: We pull up a chair at Yorebridge House in the heart of the Yorkshire Dales and quickly remember why this is undoubtedly one of our favourite restaurants. The post YORE IN FOR A TREAT appeared first on Beyond Magazine.

item.title: TWO DECADES OF GREAT DESIGN
item.description: Renowned British furniture retailer, Heal’s, this year marked its 20th anniversary at the Leeds-based interiors store, Redbrick, with a showcase of their favourite and most coveted furniture pieces from the last two decades. The post TWO DECADES OF GREAT DESIGN appeared first on Beyond Magazine.

item.title: THE INSIDER
item.description: We’re here to prove that neutrals are anything but boring. Layer in plenty of texture, from velvet cushions to natural wood and soft boucle, to bring depth and drama to a look that’s as cosy as it is sophisticated. The post THE INSIDER appeared first on Beyond Magazine.

item.title: YOUR CARRIAGE AWAITS
item.description: Beyond reports on the success of Yorkshire’s premium bed brand showroom The Carriage, who this year celebrate 10 years in business. The post YOUR CARRIAGE AWAITS appeared first on Beyond Magazine.

item.title: INTERIOR MOTIVE
item.description: One of our favourite furniture stores is the incredible Pool Bank Vintage Interiors where a treasure trove of collectables, amazing art and mid-century furniture can always be found. The post INTERIOR MOTIVE appeared first on Beyond Magazine.

item.title: NORTHERN ROCK
item.description: Marking 60 years of Leeds Conservatoire, a new exhibition, Music Leeds Us, looks back on the city’s unique musical heritage and pays tribute to a legendary Leeds gig venue which hosted iconic acts like Oasis, Coldplay, Pulp, The Verve and Nirvana. The post NORTHERN ROCK appeared first on Beyond Magazine.

item.title: MORE PILLS ‘N THRILLS
item.description: In celebration of the 35th anniversary of their classic album ‘Pills ‘n Thrills And Bellyaches’, the Happy Mondays are heading out on a UK tour this spring. We caught up with Shaun Ryder and Bez to look back at the madness, music and mayhem of their life. The post MORE PILLS ‘N THRILLS appeared first on Beyond Magazine.

item.title: LEEDS LEEDS LEEDS
item.description: A new publication charting the glory days of Leeds United between 1998 and 2003 and featuring the brilliant photography of Justin Slee has been released and is a must for any Leeds fan. The post LEEDS LEEDS LEEDS appeared first on Beyond Magazine.

item.title: A PAINT OF GENIUS
item.description: We catch up with renowned painter and sculptor Stephen Charlton to hear about his incredible new series of artwork that captures the perfect pint in all its glory. The post A PAINT OF GENIUS appeared first on Beyond Magazine.
